integrity: The proof derives the partial-function relation directly from the defining modal-ideal and countable-intersection axioms, constructs the quotient isomorphism explicitly, proves the converse, and checks the smallest obstruction. The primary 2026 paper was inspected at its definitions of modal sigma-ideals and marked modal measurable spaces, its functional dynamical-system example, and its modal Loomis-Sikorski representation theorem.
scientific_limitations: The classification applies to finite marked modal measurable spaces. It does not extend directly to infinite sigma-fields, where the null ideal need not be principal and atom arguments can fail. The exact result concerns finite representations, not the minimum infinite cardinality of representations.
title: Finite modal measurable quotients are exactly partial-function frames
